entries.author: mike
entries.summary: Total-level alerts fire only for exactly 1750/2000/2200; max cape (2277) alert is dropped, not kept as a fourth threshold.
entries.detail: Asked the developer whether reaching max total level (2277 / max cape) should keep its own alert alongside the new 1750/2000/2200 thresholds, or be dropped since it wasn't in the explicit list. Developer chose to drop it too - only exactly 1750, 2000, and 2200 trigger an alert now.

entries.author: mike
entries.summary: Screenshot support required no AlertsApiClient or Plugin-registration changes.
entries.detail: AlertsApiClient already exposed a (token, kind, summary, title, byte[] pngBytes, callback) overload used by AccomplishmentLootListener, and both PetDropListener/SkillMilestoneListener were already Guice-registered in CatastrophicEventsPlugin. Work was confined to injecting ScreenshotCapture into both listeners and routing their sendAlert calls through the existing screenshot-carrying overload.

entries.author: mike
entries.summary: Live-fire verification not possible in this environment.
entries.detail: Neither a real pet drop nor a live total-level-milestone chat message can be triggered from this dev environment. Verified via ./gradlew compileJava (BUILD SUCCESSFUL) and code review only. Consistent with WRN-006's existing caveat about PetDropListener's chat pattern being unconfirmed against a live client - flagging as a follow-up smoke test for the next time either fires live.

entries.author: system
entries.summary: Verification passed - functional UAT deferred to post-ship live testing.
entries.detail: Developer confirmed dev UAT cannot be performed pre-ship: pet drops and total-level thresholds are real-game-only events not reproducible in this environment. Verification is based on ./gradlew compileJava (BUILD SUCCESSFUL), convention adherence, and no open blockers/new concerns. Developer will confirm the 8-item UAT checklist (pet screenshot, 1750/2000/2200 screenshot alerts, max-cape/other-threshold suppression, regression of untouched skill/XP alerts, config toggle gating) against a live client after this ships.

entries.author: mike
entries.summary: Shipped directly to main with no PR, bypassing the documented feature/bugfix -> staging -> main flow.
entries.detail: Developer explicitly requested skipping the PR and staging steps entirely: 'just get it into main'. Branch bugfix/fix-pet-total-level-alerts was fast-forward merged straight into main (commit 628180b) and pushed, then the branch was deleted locally and on origin. No PR link exists for this task as a result.

entries.detail: Bumped runelite-plugin.properties version to 1.2.2 (commit 99185d3820540c12853b7e134687e7c005b02114 on main), following this repo's existing pattern of a version-bump commit after a functional fix. Updated the sibling ../plugin-hub fork's plugins/catastrophic-events manifest (branch update-catastrophic-events-v1.2.2, based on upstream/master) to point at that commit, pushed to the mikeyf06/plugin-hub fork, and the developer opened runelite/plugin-hub PR #16817 to publish this update to the RuneLite Plugin Hub.
